title: Pathology Transport: Optimal-Transport Explanations for Clinical Data, and When Their Heatmaps (Fail to) Localize Disease
abstract: arXiv:2608.17370v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative models promise a route to explainable clinical AI: rather than probe a classifier, model the distributions of healthy and diseased patients and read explanations off the geometry between them. We build such a system - an optimal-transport rectified flow trained between two clinical distributions - and use it to ask a pointed question the field too rarely tests: do the resulting explanation heatmaps actually localize disease? On tabular tumour biomarkers (Breast Cancer Wisconsin) a single flow yields per-patient counterfactuals, an unsupervised malignancy score (AUROC 0.91; 0.93 +/- 0.01 across five seeds), and a label-free attribution that agrees with a supervised classifier (r ~ 0.5) - a compact, honest interpretability engine, though it never out-predicts logistic regression. Moving to chest X-rays, we show the transport heatmap is a population-level signal, not a localiser; a reconstruction-based, identity-preserving varian

translated_title: 病理传输：临床数据的最优传输解释，及其热图（未能）定位疾病之时
translated_abstract: 生成模型有望为可解释的临床AI提供一条途径：与其探究分类器，不如对健康与患病患者的分布进行建模，并从两者之间的几何关系中读取解释。我们构建了这样一个系统——在两个临床分布之间训练的最优传输整流流——并用它来提出一个该领域很少检验的尖锐问题：所生成的解释热图是否真正定位了疾病？在表格型肿瘤生物标志物（威斯康星乳腺癌）上，单个流能产生每患者的反事实样本、无监督恶性评分（AUROC 0.91；五个种子下0.93±0.01），以及一种与监督分类器一致的无标签归因（r~0.5）——这是一个紧凑而诚实的可解释性引擎，尽管它从未超越逻辑回归的预测性能。转向胸部X光片，我们表明传输热图是一种人群级信号，而非定位器；一种基于重建、保持身份的变体...
tldr: 本文构建了基于最优传输的整流流模型用于临床数据解释，并揭示其热图在表格数据上有效但在影像数据上仅反映人群信号而非疾病定位，强调了可解释性方法的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper builds an optimal-transport rectified flow for clinical data interpretation, showing its heatmaps work on tabular data but serve as population-level signals rather than disease localizers on imaging, highlighting limitations of explainability methods.
